name: page-frame-alignment
description: Single-column panes put the page title on the same left axis as the content they name: the session header joins the transcript measure, the spawn header joins the form, and the settings title stays on the nav axis rather than the content axis.

mutation.declaration: panescaffold.module.css: remove the .pane:has(> .body[data-pane-scaffold^="session:"]) > .header and .pane:has(> .body[data-pane-scaffold="spawn"]) > .header padding-inline rule
mutation.note: Without the rule the header keeps its 24px inset and the title sits 204px left of the 704px reading column at 1440px.
